standard_en.summary: The read mode; the values below include what changing gear does.
standard_en.effect: Switching the enum changes algorithm or resource behaviour.

optionDescriptions.prefetch_thread: A background thread reads and decompresses ahead so it overlaps with compute.
optionDescriptions.sync: Read a block, compute a block: simple, and prone to idle waiting.
